purpose: Create and capacity-screen one conservative point-in-time factor from directors, supervisors, executives, and related persons' direct open-market transactions without reading any price or forward-return field.

source.provider: Eastmoney public directors-supervisors-executives share-change data center

point_in_time_policy.regulatory_basis: Relevant persons are generally required to report share changes within two trading days; the public cross-exchange source does not expose a uniformly reliable historical filing timestamp.
point_in_time_policy.conservative_availability: close of the third local trading session strictly after TDATE, one full trading session beyond the two-trading-day reporting window
point_in_time_policy.residual_risk: A late filing beyond the reporting window can still make the synthetic availability date earlier than actual public availability; this limitation must remain explicit in every downstream audit.

aggregation.buy_share: count of valid direct-market buy rows divided by count of all valid direct-market buy and sell rows for the instrument and conservative event date
aggregation.event_count: count of valid direct-market buy and sell rows for the instrument and conservative event date
aggregation.latest_transaction_date: maximum source TDATE among the aggregated rows

snapshot_contract.direction_and_sign_consistency: BDFX must be 增持 with positive CHANNUM or 减持 with negative CHANNUM; zero, missing, or inconsistent rows are excluded and counted
snapshot_contract.mechanical_change_policy: Rows outside the exact direct-open-market reason whitelist are excluded and counted; equity incentives, bonus issues, issuance, inheritance, agreement transfer, and other non-market mechanics never enter the factor.

factor.name: insider_open_market_buy_share
factor.mechanism: A higher share of actual direct-market insider purchase rows may signal stronger near-term informed demand than contemporaneous insider sale rows.
